simple.meaning: עַזְמָוֶת (ʻAzmâveth) appears 8 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah, beginning at 2 Samuel 23:31. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עַזְמָוֶת (H5820) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עַזְמָוֶת through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

majorEvents.label: Genealogy
majorEvents.evidenceText: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

timeline.evidenceText: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.
Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;
Over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the treasures in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the towers, was Jonathan the son of Uzziah;
also from Beth Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had built themselves villages around Jerusalem.

definitions.short: Azmaveth , the name of three Israelites and of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H5820. Azmaveth I. עַזְמָ֫וֶת proper name, masculine A ᵐ5 L usually Αζμωθ , Ασμωθ : 1. a. one of David's heroes 2Sam 23:31 ; 1Chr 11:33 , B Ασβωθ . b. father of two of David's men 1Chr 12:3 . c. officer of David 1Chr 27:25 . 2 Benjamite name 1Chr 8:36 ; 9:42 , B Σαλμω , Γαβαωθ .
